summary.intent: Execute all 9 plans in phase 66 (API Schema Cutover, Publish Gate & Tombstone) using wave-based parallel worktree execution across 5 waves, implementing atomic CAS/tombstone IPNS publish, shares descriptor-ref model cutover, schema migration, API client regen, sdk-core/web compile gates, and an e2e proof suite.
summary.outcome: All 9 plans executed and merged; full API build green (767/0 jest), monorepo typecheck passing end-to-end, live schema migrated, and the sdk-e2e proof suite achieved 5/5 after fixing a pubKey supplement gap in the API's network-resolve path and correcting wrong DB name in test seeding helpers.

repo: worktree.baseRef='head' means worktrees fork from live HEAD so inter-wave merges never hit base-mismatch halts
The deletion safety guard in bin/lib/worktree-safety.cjs is unconditional — no override flag; any branch with file deletions must be merged manually
app.module.ts and apps/api/scripts/generate-openapi.ts both imported the deleted ShareKey entity — orphans not covered by any plan's files_modified
users.publicKey stores the 130-char uncompressed secp256k1 auth key; sdk-e2e must look it up in cipherbox_test (apps/api/.env DB_DATABASE), not cipherbox

A duplicate WidenShareKeyType1743100000000 row in the migrations table caused TypeORM 0.3.28 to falsely report 'No migrations are pending'; workaround was direct psql DDL + manual migration row insert

Ed25519 IPNS identity records from delegated routing omit pubKey by design (name IS the key); the DB-cached resolve path supplements it via publicKeyFromIpnsName but the seqFloor network-serve path did not — causing the strict sdk-core client to always fail closed on at-floor serves
cipherbox-mock-ipns-routing stores and returns raw protobuf bytes verbatim — it does not strip signature fields; missing pubKey on network records is a wire-format property, not mock behavior
The sdk-e2e test:single script uses --testPathPattern (removed in vitest 3.x); direct vitest positional filter is needed instead
pnpm api:generate's trailing && pnpm lint:fix runs eslint repo-wide, so it exits non-zero whenever web/sdk-core have errors — the meaningful deliverable is the regenerated client, not lint exit code
@cipherbox/crypto has no dist/ in fresh worktrees after pnpm install --prefer-offline; must build crypto first to unblock ipns module resolution

code.finding: resolveRecord seqFloor gate: shared-folder rows with null signedRecord apply a seq floor against the network record; gate-pass serves the network record but previously didn't supplement pubKey

Code comment acknowledges network records 'do NOT carry the signature fields a strict client needs to verify' — the fix supplements pubKey from publicKeyFromIpnsName(name) when signatureV2+data are present
hasSigData gates on signatureV2 && data && pubKey; missing pubKey from network records caused sig fields to be stripped from the resolve response before the fix
pubKey is intentionally omitted from parsed Ed25519 identity IPNS records (name is the key); downstream consumers that need pubKey must reconstruct it from the ipnsName

After 66-02's atomic CAS rewrite, upsertIpnsRecord uses createQueryBuilder().update() not findOne/save; the spec mock needed a chainable createQueryBuilder mock with mockQbExecute defaulting to { affected: 1 }

workflow: Serialize git worktree add calls (one per message) to avoid .git/config.lock races when dispatching parallel wave agents
Run targeted per-package builds for post-merge gates during intentional intermediate-red states rather than the full monorepo, to avoid drowning signal in known breakage
When the cleanup-wave helper aborts at the first deletion, inspect each branch's diffstat independently to validate scope before manual merge — faster than fighting the helper
Deferred spec updates (e.g., ipns.service.spec.ts excluded from 66-02) must be caught and fixed at the orchestrator post-merge test gate, not carried forward
The at-floor e2e scenario requires psql seeding of null signedRecord rows; psql helpers must target DB_DATABASE from api/.env (cipherbox_test), not the default postgres DB name
SDK_E2E_SECRET in the test harness defaults to a different value than TEST_LOGIN_SECRET in apps/api/.env; always pass the env var explicitly when running sdk-e2e locally

friction: Unconditional deletion guard in cleanup-wave helper required manual git merge for both Wave 1 (66-03 deleted share_keys DTOs) and Wave 2 (66-04 deleted obsolete spec files) — the guard provides no override path
Two orphaned ShareKey imports (app.module.ts and generate-openapi.ts) not covered by any plan's files_modified caused post-merge failures and a deviated 66-06 auto-fix
Duplicate WidenShareKeyType migration row caused TypeORM false 'no pending migrations'; required direct psql DDL workaround instead of standard migration:run
Test 15's psql seeding helpers hardcoded -d cipherbox instead of the API's actual cipherbox_test database — caused user lookup to return empty and Test 15 to fail even after the main bug was fixed
SDK_E2E_SECRET mismatch (harness default vs api/.env) caused 401 at e2e fixture setup on first run
sdk-e2e test:single script uses removed --testPathPattern jest flag; had to discover the correct vitest positional filter invocation
The running API process had a process manager auto-restarting it, complicating manual pid management when restarting after dist rebuild

pubKey supplement gap in the network-resolve path was not caught during plan execution — only surfaced during the orchestrator's e2e gate, requiring an unplanned fix + spec update + API rebuild + restart cycle
open_items: Phase 68: full web share/invite consumer rewrite (66-08 only added Phase-68 throw-stubs matching the 62-08/63-65 precedent)
Phase 68: durable high-water mark (ROT-07) for sdk-core — 66-07 only wired the optional generation argument to the publish primitives, no IndexedDB/journal persistence
cipherbox-mock-ipns-routing (:3001) was unhealthy during the session — its health should be verified before relying on the seqFloor at-floor network-serve path in future e2e runs
sdk-e2e test:single script uses a removed vitest flag and should be updated to the correct vitest positional invocation
The TypeORM duplicate migration row (WidenShareKeyType1743100000000) in the migrations table was worked around but not removed — the root cause of the duplicate entry is unresolved
